Beat 1: **She walked away from an abusive marriage with thirty-six cents, then became the Queen of Rock 'n' Roll.**

Beat 2: Born November 26, 1939, Tina Turner would be 87 today, originating from Brownsville, Tennessee.

Beat 3: Picking cotton as a child in rural Tennessee, she escaped an abusive marriage in 1976 with just thirty-six cents.

Beat 4: Working odd cleaning jobs and playing small Vegas lounges, she refused to let her voice stay silenced.

Beat 5: Releasing Private Dancer at age forty-four made history, winning eight Grammys and selling over one hundred million records.

Beat 6: Stepping onto the big screen in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome, she proved her fierce charisma conquered cinema too.

Beat 7: Inducted twice into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, her unstoppable resilience remains timeless.

Beat 8: **What is Tina Turner's greatest hit: 'What's Love Got to Do with It' or 'The Best'?**
posts.comment:
**The secret behind the Queen of Rock 'n' Roll:**
• Born Anna Mae Bullock in Brownsville, Tennessee, picking cotton with her family before moving to St. Louis.
• Left her abusive marriage in 1976 with only thirty-six cents and a Mobil gas card.
• Won eight Grammy Awards, starred in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome, and entered the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame twice.

Which Tina Turner anthem gives you chills every single time: 'Proud Mary' or 'The Best'?
posts.reel_script: Before selling out stadiums worldwide and winning eight Grammy Awards, a young woman from rural Tennessee fled an abusive marriage in the middle of the night with just thirty-six cents in her pocket. Cleaning houses and singing in small lounges, she staged a historic comeback at forty-four with Private Dancer and conquered cinema in Mad Max. Remembering her on her birthday, which song is your favorite?
posts.reel_caption: Did you know Tina Turner walked away from everything with just thirty-six cents before staging one of music's greatest comebacks at forty-four? What is her best song? #TinaTurner #QueenOfRock #MusicLegend
